# ForumIAS

> India's most trusted Civil Services and UPSC IAS exam preparation platform offering comprehensive coaching, community learning, and curated study resources since 2012.

ForumIAS provides end-to-end UPSC Civil Services exam preparation through its academy in Delhi, interactive community forum, detailed subject guides, and current affairs tracking. The platform combines expert coaching with peer learning and maintains extensive reference materials for all exam stages including prelims, mains, and interview.

## Key Topics

- UPSC (Union Public Service Commission)
- IAS (Indian Administrative Service)
- Civil Services Examination
- UPSC Prelims & Mains
- IAS Interview Preparation
- Indian Polity & Constitution
- Indian Economy
- Environment & Ecology
- Current Affairs
- Government Schemes
- Indian Forest Service (IFS)
- Exam Strategy & Topper Profiles
- Foundation Programs
- Community Learning
- Study Resources & Guides

## Core Platforms

- [ForumIAS Academy - Best UPSC Coaching Institute in Delhi](https://academy.forumias.com): ForumIAS academy offering comprehensive UPSC IAS coaching and foundation programs in Delhi
- [ForumIAS Community Forum](https://forumias.com/community): The Knowledge Network for Civil Services Preparation - India's most trusted community for Civil Services since 2012 with peer learning and discussion forums
- [ForumIAS Blog Hub](https://forumias.com/blog): ForumIAS blog hub with UPSC IAS preparation guides, exam strategy, and topper profiles

## Subject-Specific Preparation Guides

- [How to Prepare Polity for UPSC Civil Services Examination](https://forumias.com/blog/polity): Indian Polity study guide for UPSC Civil Services with constitution topics
- [Economy Questions UPSC Mains & IAS EXAM](https://forumias.com/blog/eco): Indian Economy preparation guide for UPSC prelims and mains examination
- [Environment For UPSC Civil Services Examination](https://forumias.com/blog/env): Environment and ecology study guide for UPSC Civil Services examination
- [How to Prepare for Indian Forest Service Examination](https://forumias.com/blog/ifs): Comprehensive Indian Forest Service exam preparation guide with topper strategies

## Exam Stages & Strategies
